caption:
A panarello wand makes foam but not microfoam for latte art, so the page prefers a commercial-style tip. Want lattes back to back? A heat exchanger or dual boiler steams right after the shot. The picks: Gaggia Classic Pro from Claude, Breville Bambino Plus from GPT. Why: 1billionmodels.com

Two AI models (Claude Opus 5.5, GPT 6.1 Sol) chose with no web access; nobody tested these products. Synthetic voice. AI-made video.
title: Espresso machine for lattes: single boiler or dual boiler?
